description: This file contains implementation of big number squaring functions, including BN_sqr and bn_sqr_normal, used for cryptographic computations in the OpenSSL library.

methods.name: BN_sqr
methods.description: Performs squaring of a big number using optimized routines based on size.

methods.name: bn_sqr_normal
methods.description: Performs normal big number squaring for arbitrary size.
